title: ShareLink
$comment: v1.0. Read-only share links to a tutorial (Phase 3, #96; docs/research/phase-3-vishwas-share-tokens.md). Only the token's SHA-256 is stored, so the full link is returned once, on creation (ShareLinkCreated). The public read GET /shared/{token} returns a Workflow (workflow.schema.json) with task_id and run_id null and its file URLs under /shared/{token}/.

expires_at.description: Null: never expires (the only choice in the MVP UI).

ShareLinkCreated.title: ShareLinkCreated
ShareLinkCreated.description: Response of POST /workflows/{id}/shares. `url` holds the secret token and is never shown again.
